description: Scan the workspace for .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.md files and package.json manifests, and build the SQLite graph at .sqlite-graph/index.db (nodes: file, symbol, heading, package; edges: imports, exports, defines, links_to, depends_on, references). tsconfig paths aliases and workspace-local packages resolve to real files. The default tree-sitter (WASM AST) engine grounds references in identifier usage; the regex heuristic engine is a fallback. Safe to re-run: it rebuilds atomically.

force.description: Accepted for symmetry; indexing always rebuilds.

ignore.description: Extra directory or file names to skip.

root.description: Workspace directory to index (defaults to the server root).

name: graph_index
title: Index workspace
